The toilet is white and features an oval-shaped seat, accompanied by a long arm on the left side that holds a small, square control panel. This panel is equipped with buttons and a cord, indicating that it is used to operate the bidet attachment. The bidet attachment is designed to provide a more hygienic and comfortable toilet experience, offering features such as massaging jets of water and adjustable temperature settings.
